text: We evaluated repeated self-distillation of the student's own labels on the HellaSwag testbed, measuring a performance gap recovered (PGR) of 0.73 with a standard error of 0.07 across num_seeds = 3 seeds. No baseline PGR was provided in the data, so this number cannot be framed as an improvement over any alternative method; it stands only as a standalone measurement of where this configuration lands. The three-seed sample is small, and the standard error of 0.07 is estimated from those same three runs, so it should be read as a rough indication of spread rather than a tight interval. Readers should also note that the finding is confined to a single testbed, and nothing here speaks to whether the effect carries over to other tasks or model pairings. Further seeds and an explicit baseline comparison would be needed before drawing any directional conclusion about the method's value.
